[cheerful] We start from the discount code condition: signing up before March 1st, 2023.

Here, the date is written in the format year-month-day: 2023, dash, 03, dash, 01 means March 1st, 2023.

The less than sign selects the customers who signed up before this date.

These 4 customers have already received their discount code.

To select the 6 others, use not: it reverses the filter’s condition.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] To reverse a group of conditions, put it between parentheses after not.

Only Léa Simon, a Parisian over 35, is left out: 9 customers remain.

Without parentheses, not only reverses the condition right after it: city equals 'Paris'.

The Parisians, including Sophie Martin, are left out, and age greater than 35 leaves out the younger ones: 3 customers remain.
